description: Glance is a self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place.
author: BigBearTechWorld

tips.before_install: A starter glance.yml is created on first run. Edit it to customize your dashboard; if it is ever left invalid or half-written, delete it and restart to get a fresh starter config. The Docker socket is mounted for the containers widget - this grants Glance root-equivalent access to Docker regardless of the read-only flag, so delete the docker-containers widget from glance.yml after install, or remove the socket volume from the compose file before deploying, if you do not want the widget.

title: Glance
